story.conflict: Her husband says he was helping neighbors during renovations and emergencies, while she never agreed to be responsible for other people's property or lose access to her own garage.

story.script: I opened the garage one Saturday and could barely reach my car. There were boxes, two folding chairs, a stroller, and an expensive bicycle I had never seen before. story.twist: When a bicycle goes missing, the supposed owner admits it was never his bicycle either; he had been storing it for someone else, creating a chain of people who all assumed the couple had accepted responsibility.

youtube.title: Our Garage Became the Neighborhood Storage Unit
